question: What will India's All-India CPI inflation rate (year-on-year) for October 2026 be?

calls.reasoning: Arithmetic anchor: Oct y/y ≈ Sep 5.54% + (Oct-2026 m/m − Oct-2025 m/m of +0.15%, old-series 197.0→197.3). Sep 2026 m/m was ~+1.1%; typical October m/m +0.6–1.2% but onion wholesale eased in late Oct (Lasalgaon ~₹55→49/kg) as kharif arrived, while fuel/transport stays elevated. Analyst anchors: Trading Economics 6.2% for Oct, Reuters poll Q3 avg 6.1%, RBI Q3 6.0%, SBI >6.5%. Median ~6.05 with ~±0.55 80% band. Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on India CPI found.
calls.dossier:
- Sep 2026 combined CPI y/y 5.54% (provisional), index 109.49 vs 103.74 Sep 2025; Aug 4.83%; food CFPI 7.74%; rural 6.08%, urban 4.88% (MoSPI via BusinessToday, 12 Oct 2026). Reuters poll had expected 5.40% (CNBC 12 Oct 2026).
- Transport services inflation 14.73%, personal transport 7.46% in Sep — oil elevated due to Middle East/Iran tensions (CNBC 12 Oct 2026).
- Old series (2012=100): Sep 2025 final 197.0, Oct 2025 provisional 197.3 → Oct 2025 m/m +0.15%; Oct 2025 y/y 0.25% (PIB Nov 2025). New-series Oct 2025 index not directly confirmed; if linked by constant factor ≈103.90.
- Arithmetic: Oct 2026 y/y ≈ 5.54 + (Oct-2026 m/m − 0.15). m/m 0% → ~5.4; +0.5% → ~5.9; +1.0% → ~6.4.
- Implied Sep 2026 m/m ≈ +1.1% (y/y jump 0.71pp over a base m/m of ~+0.4%).
- Historical October m/m (old series): 2022 ~+0.8, 2023 ~+0.6, 2024 ~+1.2, 2025 +0.15.
- Onion: Lasalgaon wholesale ~₹55/kg Sep → ₹49/kg late Oct as kharif arrivals from Karnataka/AP rose; mid-Oct temporary rally (avg ₹3,351→4,050/qtl, Oct 10→19) when arrivals dipped (FreePressJournal/FreshPlaza, Oct 2026). Onion y/y stays very high due to low 2025 base.
- Forecasts: Trading Economics Oct forecast 6.2%; Reuters poll (Oct 19-26) Q3 FY27 (Oct-Dec) average 6.1%; RBI Q3 projection 6.0%; SBI Research >6.5% for Oct-Nov. RBI hiked rates in Oct 2026.

Expected Oct m/m ~+0.45–0.5%: cereals/pulses/edible oil and energy up, festive season, offset by silver -20%/gold -7% and kharif onion easing. Median ~6.0, slightly below quarterly anchors (RBI Q3 6.0, Reuters Q3 6.1, TE 6.2, SBI >6.5). No human prediction market found (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold none, per runs).
calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) Oct 2025 base-month m/m: Run1 +0.15 (old series), Run3 +0.2-0.4 (estimate), Run2 ~0 (ThePrint new-series flat-price projection 5.54 for Oct). I favor the new-series ThePrint figure because the question resolves off that series; base ~0-0.15. (2) Sep 2026 m/m: Run2 +0.69 (cited) vs Runs1/3 ~1.0-1.1 (implied). The cited figure is more credible; this suggests momentum is less hot than Runs1/3 assumed. Judgment: the Oct m/m size. The precious-metals crash and onion easing weigh against upside from cereals and energy, so I take ~+0.45-0.5 and a median of 6.0. No web access this run, so no market check was repeated.
